strings.zh: 阿波罗『解密进展到什么程度了？

strings.zh: 阿波罗『但首领就是因为{NEWLINE}太过执着于自己的原则,{CLEAR}才导致关东火箭队被迫解散。{CLEAR}所以我不会像首领一样{CLEAR}拘泥于这些不实用的东西。
strings.en: Archer: But it was because the{NEWLINE}Boss clung so stubbornly to{CLEAR}his principles that Team Rocket{CLEAR}in Kanto was forced to disband.{SCROLL}So unlike the Boss, I won’t let such{NEWLINE}impractical things tie my hands.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『你们这些骗子！

strings.zh: 阿波罗『感谢你为我们火箭队{NEWLINE}统治世界做出的卓越贡献,{CLEAR}现在请你用自己的死亡{CLEAR}为这份贡献画上一个完美的句号吧。

strings.zh: 阿波罗『不愧是击败坂木首领的人,{NEWLINE}如果公平对决我肯定不是你的对手。{CLEAR}但生死决斗从来不讲公平,{CLEAR}你刚战斗完一身疲惫,{CLEAR}这就是要你命的最好时机！

Over a year ago, Team{CLEAR}Rocket set their sights on my{CLEAR}research into ancient legends.{SCROLL}They brought me here to crack the{NEWLINE}methods for catching legendary{CLEAR}Pokémon hidden in those legends.{SCROLL}Prof. Hale: At first I refused.{NEWLINE}But they threatened the life of{CLEAR}my daughter, Molly, so in the{CLEAR}end I had to do as they said...

strings.zh: 秀力博士『最初我只是帮他们{NEWLINE}解密了一些不重要的情报,{CLEAR}像是凤王的彩虹羽毛可能在哪、{CLEAR}呆呆兽之井里保存着求雨的铃铛、{CLEAR}城都三圣兽确实封印在烧焦塔。{SCROLL}秀力博士『但是火箭队里的那个冥王{NEWLINE}居然用我提供的这点情报,{CLEAR}想出了释放和捕捉三圣兽的方法。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: At first I only gave{NEWLINE}them unimportant information, like{CLEAR}where Ho-Oh’s Rainbow Wing might{CLEAR}be, that the bell for summoning rain{CLEAR}is kept in Slowpoke Well, and that{CLEAR}Johto’s legendary beasts really{CLEAR}are sealed in the Burned Tower.{SCROLL}Prof. Hale: But that Charon{NEWLINE}in Team Rocket used even that{CLEAR}little bit of information to{CLEAR}work out a way to release and{CLEAR}catch the legendary beasts.

It uses{CLEAR}Electric-type Pokémon as a power{CLEAR}source to send out radio waves at a{CLEAR}special frequency.{SCROLL}Weak Pokémon within range of the waves{NEWLINE}evolve and obey Team Rocket’s orders.{CLEAR}The system is designed for dealing with{CLEAR}the huge numbers of ordinary Trainers.{SCROLL}Prof. Hale: Team Rocket calls this plan{NEWLINE}to conquer every Trainer ‘Project R.’
